{{Quote|When enthusiasts stage recreations of the battle they tend to use replica great axes and swords known from the excavation of Taung burial sites on Roon. But by the time the Taungs reached Roon these were ritual objects&mdash;species capable of traveling through hyperspace don't still rely on edged weapons. Nor do you find such weapons still used by societies as sophisticated as the Zhell nations. It's as if you staged a recreation of the Siege of Ramsir with the Imperial Army limited to parade sabers.|Hu Jibwe, "A LONG TIME AGO..."|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
The '''Siege of Ramsir''' was an engagement<ref name="Author's Cut" /> that was fought in the vicinity<ref name="Battlenamia" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Ramsir system/Legends|Ramsir system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> at some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="19 BBY" /> and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. It saw the participation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

In 2 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], the ''[[Imperial Center Today]]'' contributor [[Eschul Shaywa]] published the article "[[A LONG TIME AGO...]]," which included comments by the military history [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]] [[Hu Jibwe]]. The latter noted that it was likely that the [[Taung/Legends|Taungs]] and the [[Battalions of Zhell]], two factions that had supposedly fought each other in a [[Zhell–Taung war|conflict]] [[200,000 BBY|two hundred thousand years]] prior, had used relatively sophisticated military technology such as aircraft and [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|nuclear bombs]], as opposed to the more primitive edged [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] commonly used in contemporary stage recreations of [[Destruction of Zhell|one]] of the conflict's battles. Jibwe further compared the contrast to a hypothetical recreation of the Siege of Ramsir in which the weaponry used by the Imperial Army was limited to [[parade saber]]s.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Siege of Ramsir was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the conflict was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the siege was later released in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from the book.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
